text:
Iris: hey team, day 1 here. trying to push a docker image to the team's ECR repo in eu-west-1 but `docker push` fails with access denied. also when i try to create a BigQuery dataset in europe-west1 i get a billing/service error. stuck on both sides and not sure who to ping.
Leo (cloud-onboarding): welcome Iris! paste the error texts and the AWS account / GCP project ids. usually these are either IAM trust issues (aws) or project billing/organization policies (gcp).
Iris: aws error:
ERROR: AccessDenied: User arn:aws:iam::310000000111:user/iris is not authorized to perform: ecr:PutImage on resource arn:aws:ecr:eu-west-1:310000000111:repository/redwood-team-demo
GCP error:
ERROR: (gcloud.bigquery.datasets.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission bigquery.datasets.create denied on project proj-iris-day1 (role roles/bigquery.admin missing)
Iris: aws account 310000000111, gcp proj proj-iris-day1
Billing Bot: Quick checks: 1) Confirm project billing link: `gcloud beta billing projects describe proj-iris-day1`. 2) Confirm Okta group membership - new hires should be in `redwood-devs`. 3) For ECR, ensure `ecr:GetAuthorizationToken` and `ecr:PutImage` allowed or that role assumption mapping exists.
Iris: billing shows linkedBillingAccount: 01Z2-Y3X4-W5V6. okta group? i joined okta but not sure group membership.
Onboard Helper: Okta group auto-add sometimes lags. Check https://redwood.internal/okta/groups and trigger a manual sync if needed. Also for ECR push confirm `aws ecr get-login-password | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 310000000111.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com` works.
Marta (infra): Iris, for ECR pushes we usually map the Okta group to an AWS role `team-ecr-pusher` that the SAML principal can assume. If your user isn't in the mapped group, you'll see PutImage denied. I'll check the mapping and Okta sync.
Nora (security): For GCP, we restrict roles on org dev folders; we avoid granting broad roles like bigquery.admin by default. For onboarding we give `roles/bigquery.dataOwner` scoped to a dataset or a temporary project-level binding if needed.
Iris: ran the ecr login step and it fails with `AccessDenied` when fetching auth token.
Marta (infra): Okta sync shows you weren't auto-added due to a timing glitch. I manually added iris@redwood.com to redwood-devs and triggered SAML sync. That should allow assume-role mapping in a few minutes.
Iris: still denied after 5 mins. any manual interim?
DevOps - Kofi: we can issue a temporary IAM role `dev-onboard-ecr` for you to assume for 6 hours and a temporary GCP binding roles/bigquery.dataOwner for proj-iris-day1 for 6 hours. Need manager sign-off. Also confirm you'll only push non-sensitive demo images.
Iris: manager approved in-thread: "approve temporary ECR and BigQuery access for iris for onboarding demo"
Marta (infra): created temporary role dev-onboard-ecr and added a policy allowing `ecr:GetAuthorizationToken`, `ecr:PutImage`, `ecr:InitiateLayerUpload`, `ecr:CompleteLayerUpload`. Trust policy allows your Okta SAML principal and expires in 6h. Ticket ACC-2051-88.
DevOps - Kofi: added temporary GCP binding: roles/bigquery.dataOwner to principal iris@redwood-saml for proj-iris-day1 for 6 hours. Ticket ACC-2051-89.
Iris: tried aws login after assume-role flow: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::310000000111:role/dev-onboard-ecr --role-session-name iris-temp` then `aws ecr get-login-password`  login and push now succeed. BigQuery dataset creation also works.
Leo (cloud-onboarding): great. two follow-ups: 1) we'll update onboarding checklist to explicitly call out Okta group sync and the ECR assume-role flow, 2) we'll add a short how-to for requesting temporary GCP dataset bindings. Can you post the commands that worked?
Iris: commands that worked:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::310000000111:role/dev-onboard-ecr --role-session-name iris-temp --duration-seconds 21600
aws ecr get-login-password --region eu-west-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 310000000111.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com
docker tag local-image:latest 310000000111.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-team-demo:day1
docker push 310000000111.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-team-demo:day1
gcloud auth login --brief
gcloud config set project proj-iris-day1
bq --location=europe-west1 mk --dataset proj-iris-day1:iris_demo_dataset
```
Iris: thanks everyone  will tear down demo images and dataset after my tests.
Nora (security): reminder: do not upload customer data to the demo dataset or images. We'll revoke temporary grants early if we detect sensitive content.
Marta (infra): Okta sync root cause tracked in OPS-2051-7; engineering fixed the race condition. I'll follow up to confirm you were added to the permanent mapping for team-ecr-pusher.
Leo (cloud-onboarding): closing notes: billing link confirmed (01Z2-Y3X4-W5V6), temp tickets ACC-2051-88 and ACC-2051-89. Iris feel free to ping if anything else. :thumbsup:
